title: State of the Trenches, 2026-W46: fees −17.5% week over week
dek: Launchpad fees were $13.86M across 14 non-overlapping venues and creator earnings $6.86M; Ni hao cat coins led narrative volume.

body.text: The covered launchpad fee subtotal for 2026-W46 (Nov 9, 2026 to Nov 15, 2026, UTC) was $13.86M across 14 non-overlapping venues, −17.5% against 2026-W45 on the same venues. 5 venues that share a fee stream with another venue are reported individually and never added.
Creator earnings — fees paid to coin creators and, depending on the venue's own definition, holders, referrers or traders — were $6.86M across 16 venues that define them, −24.0% week over week.
By share of the subtotal, pump.fun gained the most (+3.5 points) and LaunchLab lost the most (-2.5 points). A share shift says where fees moved, not why.

Trading in the coins of the tracked narratives totalled $408.75M for the week, counting a coin once when it belongs to more than one narrative (the per-narrative totals add up to $412.34M). This is the volume of identified coins across their indexed pools, not of the whole market.

Ni hao cat coins carried the most volume among narratives collected during the week: $164.61M (partial: some member-days were not observed). It was first observed this week, so no week-over-week change is reported.
First observed this week: Ni hao cat coins, Nvidia CEO scandal coins. A narrative's first week has no meaningful prior week, so no change is reported for it.

Collection paused during the week: GTA 6 launch coins, Nvidia CEO scandal coins, Super Intelligence coins, Zcash launchpad coins, Be Like José coins. Their members stay members; their totals after the pause are partial, not zero.
